title: Exodus 40:20 and Genesis 50:26 — the same Hebrew word for ark and coffin
summary: Exodus 40:20 (the testimony put into the ark) and Genesis 50:26 (Joseph put in a coffin in Egypt) in English and Hebrew, with the Hebrew word ארן/ארון shown in the same colour in both verses, translated 'ark' in one and 'coffin' in the other. Joseph and Egypt are also colour-matched to their Hebrew words, and [Moses] is in square brackets in the English.

text.text: 20 Then [Moses] took the testimony and put it into the ark, and attached the poles to the ark, and put the mercy seat on top of the ark.
20 ויקח ויתן את־העדת אל־הארן וישם את־הבדים על־הארן ויתן את־הכפרת על־הארן מלמעלה׃
26 So Joseph died, being 110 years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
26 וימת יוסף בן־מאה ועשר שנים ויחנטו אתו ויישם בארון במצרים׃

uncertain: Only part of the colour-coded Hebrew word (ארן) is highlighted in each verse; exact spelling of the highlighted portion in 'הארן' judged from the image.
